correctness.rationale: The Caputo integral equation and continuity at the initial state force y(t)=K+F(K)t^α/Γ(α+1)+o(t^α), including α=1. In the publisher PDF, Eq. (5.8) and its definitions of the zeroth products support the frozen comparison. Eq. (5.9) changes the symptomatic loss and recovery input, giving first-coefficient residuals φ_s(K₃−K₄) and ρ_h(K₅−K₆). Eq. (5.10) repeats the symptomatic loss error and uses the exposed instead of susceptible state in the natural mortality term of the susceptible equation; it also swaps the incidence pairings in both rows. The sign of the susceptible residual in the frozen proof is correct. These differences are nonzero as polynomial identities; the non-incidence differences alone suffice. Transfer balance requires consistent pairings but does not distinguish a simultaneous swap; the intended labels are established separately by Table 1 and (5.8). Section 6 explicitly attributes its approximations to (5.10), but this does not establish what the unavailable implementation computed. VERIFICATION.md and verify.py were inspected, not executed; the script checks the transcribed expressions, not their provenance or any trajectory. The analytic first-term comparison is decisive.
